description: This file defines the BookingHistoryViewerService class, which manages retrieval and sorting of booking audit logs and form response logs for a booking, including creating log entries from form responses.

classes.name: BookingHistoryViewerService
classes.description: Main service class for viewing booking history, including audit logs and form submission logs.

methods.name: sortLogsReverseChronologically
methods.description: Sorts an array of booking history logs in reverse chronological order based on their timestamps.

methods.name: getFormAuditLogsForBooking
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs form audit logs for a specific booking, currently by replicating form responses.

methods.name: getHistoryForBooking
methods.description: Main method to retrieve combined audit logs and form response logs for a booking, sorted in reverse chronological order.

methods.name: createFormSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Creates a booking history log entry from a form response, including extracting email and timestamp.
